'''Bloodrage''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] that makes an axe's wielder stronger and tougher when their health is low.

== Obtaining ==
Bloodrage comes on the [[Hatchet]], an iron axe sold by an expert-level [[Lumberjack]] for one [[Obol]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/leatherworker/4/hatchet.json}}</ref> No blessing or book gives it, and it cannot appear on random loot.

== Behavior ==
Every tick that a player holds an axe with Bloodrage in the main hand and has 10 health ({{Hp|10}}) or less, they receive {{EffectLink|Strength}} I and {{EffectLink|Resistance}} II for 1 second, and red dust particles appear around them. The effects keep being renewed until the player's health rises above 10.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/bloodrage.mcfunction}}</ref>

Bloodrage can be applied to any axe. Its anvil cost multiplier is 0.
